notes.title: Updates based on user feedback!
notes.notes:
[p]Shooting will no longer move the player if the shot wouldn't lift you off the ground!

Save and exit in the in-game menu will now just be close for the menu. This was a bad location for an exit button.[/p]

notes.title: Better movement and menu buttons!
notes.notes:
Improved movement from player feedback -- you will not move on the ground if the shot would not lift you in the air.

Changed the exit game button to an exit menu button, as this was a bad place for it.
